verdict_msg: HARD_PASS: engineered WRITE-LOCK wrapper protects core -- locked shards survive 4000 later writes at recall>=0.95 (vs unlocked baseline 0.00). Protection via WRAPPER routing (refuse writes to locked shards), NO algebra change. Validates Sprint-4 engineered-wrapper thesis: missing features = engineering choices, not substrate limits. locked=1.000 baseline=0.000 after 4000 writes
